newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - PacMag appoints former Coles executive.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - PacMag appoints former Coles executive.

text.p: Pacific Magazines and Printing Ltd (PMP) said on Thursday it had appointed former Coles Myer executive Stephen Goddard as managing director of its new-media division, PMP said on Thursday.

Goddard, ex-head of Coles Myer's Officeworks Superstores, will oversee the operation and expansion of PMP's new-media communication services, including electronic publishing, Show-Ads Interactive, Pinpoint and Pacific Metromail, it said.
PMP also announced the appointment of former Sydney managing director of Pacific Publications John Motion to the new post of chief executive, Pacific Publications.

This appointment follows the resignation of Pacific Publications' Melbourne chief executive, Colin Duck, to pursue private interests, the company said. The magazine publisher is 45 percent-owned by News Corp Ltd.
